Same block repeats per work-history entry as public-candidate-work-history-address-<n>-*.
control_families.dropdownlist: div[role=combobox].rw-dropdownlist (react-widgets) id='info.<field>' with data-for='<full question text>' and aria-owns='<id>__listbox'; child span.rw-select 'open dropdown'. Displayed value '--' when blank. Options could NOT be observed via bridge click/ArrowDown/picker click.
control_families.radiogroup: div[role=radiogroup] wrapping native input[type=radio] name='info.howDidYouHearAboutUs' with label text = value; employer-custom option sets; pl-03 marked aria-required=true.

Do not send a resume to #btn-forceResume unless auto-parse is intended.

provider_hint.for_jev: Paylocity: multi-step wizard, no <form>. Step 1 = contact + address + salary + source + optional work history. Labels are plain text with '(required)' suffix; dropdown labels are in data-for. Dropdown option lists are unknown to the runtime until a human opens them — do not guess; request observation. 'Next Step' is not the final submit; the final control was never observed, so treat every submit-looking button after Step 1 as a stop boundary.
